records.title: Budget Allocation for West Bengal
details: b, c & e: Deshpran - Nandigram (18.5km) Line was sanctioned in 2009-10 at cost of Rs. 121.44 crores. The entire Project length is located in East Midnapore District. The project could not progress due to problems in land acquisition and was kept in abeyance. In April 2023 it was decided to re-start the work.

records.title: Vacant post of ATCs
details: a: Air Traffic is managed by Airports Authority of India (AAI) through a total sanctioned strength of 5537 Air Traffic Controllers (ATCOs). The total vacancies of ATCOs is 1279.
